videos.title: How Do Fossils Form?: Crash Course Geology #18
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Everybody dies, but few fossilize. In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll learn how fossils form and why they’re so rare. Although very few living things ever become fossils, those that /do/ help us understand Earth’s history and how life came to be as it is today.

videos.title: The Mystery Behind Earth’s Missing Rocks: Crash Course Geology #16
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
How did over one billion years of history go missing? In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll tour the Grand Canyon and discover how geologists read its rocky layers like chapters in Earth’s biography. We’ll also explore theories about why some of those chapters have disappeared.
